entries.23fd938919f31192: A guarantee product covering unpaid child support after divorce, under which the company acts as joint guarantor and assumes the risk of non-payment of child support.
entries.6abff107b6e5bf0c: This service outsources, in whole or in part, operations related to guarantee services, including acceptance of rental applications, screening, notices of unpaid amounts, and support for receivables management. It uses its own screening system based on a scoring model and its own call center.
entries.6d9b7f2c2bc5fe1a: This service outsources insurance solicitation operations to real estate management companies. Through collaboration with major non-life insurers and others, it handles insurance solicitation and policy administration operations.
entries.80ce17840b0c05ba: A guarantee product covering hospitalization costs and similar charges, under which the company acts as joint guarantor and assumes the risk of non-payment of the patient's share of hospitalization costs and similar payments. As a safeguard against the risk of arrears, the company, in principle, concludes insurance contracts with non-life insurance companies.
entries.92644d372836def4: A business that provides mainly rent guarantees, along with nursing care cost guarantees, medical cost guarantees and child support guarantees. Guarantee products are customized for each property management company, and when arrears occur, the company makes subrogation payments and seeks to recover the claims for reimbursement. The subsidiary Premier Life Co., Ltd. also handles rent guarantees. Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥11,049 million.
entries.956cc54464ad9083: Landlords and tenants of rental housing
entries.9b14c2f17208c5d9: A single segment, the Comprehensive Guarantee Services Business. Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥12,283 million; it consists of three services: the guarantee business, the solutions business and the IT services business. Headcount as of March 31, 2026 was 308 employees, and there are two consolidated subsidiaries: Premier Life Co., Ltd. and Carol System Co., Ltd.
entries.9ec165b012b44e99: A business that, drawing on know-how developed in rent guarantees, undertakes guarantee-related operations and provides notification and payment systems. Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥909 million.
entries.a2dbd4e641c6a28e: A service in which, when a lease agreement or similar is concluded, a guarantee commission contract is entered into and the company or a subsidiary acts as joint guarantor, assuming the risk of unpaid rent and other charges. There are guarantee products of the subrogation-payment type, which make subrogation payments when arrears occur, and products with a rent-payment credit service, provided through a business alliance with a major credit company.
entries.d09f77ce9a4add71: This service adds to bulk SMS (Short Message Service) transmission operations a credit card payment function called the “Raku-Kure” service, along with call center functions and other features.
entries.d6eff199a03b331d: A guarantee product covering nursing care facility fees and similar charges, under which the company acts as joint guarantor and assumes the risk of unpaid fees and similar charges.
entries.ed9efa1f50b518f6: A comprehensive guarantee services company that provides rent guarantees as its core, cost guarantees for nursing care, medical care and child support, and contracted services for guarantee-related operations.
